title: MAH MHTCET 2026 Attempt 2 Examination
description: The MHT-CET (Maharashtra Common Entrance Test) is a state-level entrance examination conducted in online (computer-based) mode. The exam pattern is based on the Maharashtra State Board syllabus, with questions from Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics/Biology, and it is multiple-choice (MCQ) in nature with no negative marking. MHT-CET provides admission mainly to government, government-aided, and private colleges in Maharashtra, offering undergraduate programs in Engineering, Technology, and Pharmacy.
